policyZh: 本登记表只保存能够约束绝对尺寸、面积、跨度或比例的来源。照片观感、旅游介绍和未定标示意图不得作为 verified 尺寸证据。
policyEn: This registry only contains sources that constrain absolute dimensions, areas, spans, or scale. Visual impressions, tourism descriptions, and unscaled diagrams must not support verified dimensions.

records.title: The design practice of the roof structure of the old library of early architecture in Wuhan University
records.publisherOrAuthor: Akbar Askar, Qiaohui Tong, Qiguo Li and Yiyao Tang / Journal of Asian Architecture and Building Engineering

measurementClaims.descriptionZh: 论文依据武汉大学档案馆结构图纸，将老图书馆主楼屋顶结构跨度列为18m×18m。
measurementClaims.descriptionEn: The paper lists the main roof structural span as 18 m by 18 m from Wuhan University archival structural drawings.

measurementClaims.value: I-shaped central main building with four auxiliary front/rear wing buildings
measurementClaims.descriptionZh: 论文将平面描述为工字形，由中央主楼和前后翼的四座附楼组成。
measurementClaims.descriptionEn: The plan is described as I-shaped, composed of a central main building and four auxiliary buildings on the front and rear wings.

records.verificationNotes: 论文为开放获取，明确说明研究团队在2015年开展详细测绘，并综合扫描整理武汉大学档案馆保存的建筑与结构图纸。18m跨度可用于主屋顶定标；论文中的其他数值仍需逐项解释其口径。

records.title: Campus Life – Wuhan University

measurementClaims.descriptionZh: 武汉大学官方页面记载老图书馆floor area为4767平方米。
measurementClaims.descriptionEn: An official Wuhan University page states a floor area of 4,767 square metres.

records.verificationNotes: 另一篇建筑学论文引用文献给出6234平方米的useable floor area。两者可能使用不同面积口径，未完成口径核对前不得据此单独缩放整个模型。
